headline: Last session: Sensex falls 319 points and Nifty closes at 25,144 as inflation and crude pressures weigh

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on investor sentiment during the last trading session.
Crude oil price pressures added to market weakness on Friday.
Benchmark indices snapped their recent winning streak during the last session.
Concerns surrounding global tech dynamics like Nvidia's crisis influenced market backdrop.
whatHappening: Sensex dropped 319 points while Nifty50 closed at 25,144 in the last session.
Shriram Finance emerged as the top loser on Friday's wrap.
Manappuram Finance shares tumbled by 4% in the last trading session.
Indian markets overall managed to extend gains for the 3rd straight week despite Friday's decline.
summary:
On the last trading day, Indian benchmarks snapped their winning streak as Sensex fell over 300 points and Nifty closed at 25,144.
Rising crude oil prices and inflation concerns dragged down sentiment across key sectors.
Despite the decline on Friday, Indian markets achieved gains for the third consecutive week overall.
